integrity: Self-contained proofs and executable direct-enumeration tests; no third-party article is embedded; independent verification has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: The all-graph identity is an exact subset sum rather than a claimed polynomial-time algorithm; the rational and multiplicity formulas apply only to simple sunlets with at least three core vertices. Two auxiliary low-order coefficients are formal extensions. Bibliographic priority is not independently certified.
title: A vertex-boundary census for minimal Roman functions on one-leaf coronas and a Pell–Lucas law for sunlets
